lines: In body of this established in body then form is determined; of consciousness-vibration-breath-functions last which grossness suṣumnā.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dehe pratiṣṭhitasyāsya tato rūpaṃ nirūpyate citspandaprāṇavṛttīnāmantyā yā sthūlatā suṣiḥ
